rule.description: Code that no runtime path can reach: definitions whose only references sit in unreachable regions or in other dead code, and statement regions shielded by constant-false guards or following a terminating statement in the same block.

checks.description: A function or method whose only incoming references occur in code that cannot execute -- inside constant-false guarded regions, after a terminating statement, inside other dead definitions, or as a bare import alias. No live statement of any live scope names it.
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The definition can never run in this build: the wiring that points to it is itself unreachable, so the code exists only as maintenance surface.

matches.evidence: Per-table sqlite_stat1 reader; its only call site sits in the statistics branch guarded by the protocol constant set below its activation level.
Memoizing wrapper around the statistics reader, called only from the same never-taken branch.
Row-footprint estimator used only by the dormant statistics branch of the table-structure view.
Module-level formatter for the statistics advisory; only the unreachable branch of the table-structure view calls it.
Export-manifest formatter; its only call site is in the guarded region of the export view, and it is also the sole in-package caller of the cost estimator E9, keeping that helper dead transitively.
Result-key encoder whose only call site sits after the error-path break inside the statement loop, so it can never be invoked while the loop runs.
Query-plan cost estimator referenced only by the dead export-manifest formatter and by an import alias in the application module.
Pool builder for the gevent server whose only call site is gated behind the disabled sizing switch in the server bootstrap.

checks.description: A statement region that cannot execute: the body of a guard whose test folds to a constant false value against module-level literal switches, or the statements following a return/raise/break/continue inside the same block.
checks.detected_relation: statement region -> no executing control-flow edge
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The region consumes runtime cost to read and maintain yet control flow provably never enters it in this build.

matches.evidence: Statistics/advisory computation guarded by a module-level protocol constant pinned below its activation level, so the branch body is unreachable whenever the view runs.
Manifest computation and response-header assignment guarded by a module-level dialect constant pinned below its activation level.
Two statements that follow the error-path break inside the statement loop and therefore never execute when the loop stops at the first failing statement.
Pool-rebuild assignment guarded by a module-level switch that is disabled in this build, so the bootstrap always uses the statically sized pool.

excluded.what: Definitions with no incoming reference anywhere in the package
examples: sqlite_web/sqlite_web.py: to_python/to_url on the dataset class family
excluded.reason: Treated as importable API surface consumed from outside the package; usage cannot be proven from inside, so the rule reports only definitions some unreachable reference actually binds.
Invoked by the interpreter or framework from outside the call graph, so absence of an in-package call site is not evidence of deadness.

examples: cached_tables and sibling cached_* accessors rendered by table templates
excluded.reason: Template rendering dispatches dynamically, so these names are live by construction and are marked live in the fixpoint.

excluded.what: Guards that depend on runtime state
excluded.reason: Tests inferring to Uninferable (request data, parameters, installed versions) never fold, so their branches stay live even when locally they look constant.
Import-time code executes by definition; the rule reports definitions and statement regions inside function/method bodies and their guards only.
